Subject: Geometry Specification Summary  

The current project focuses on calculating the volume of a cylinder. For this shape, the base radius is set to 4.5 units and the height to 12.0 units. In addition to the cylinder, the reference data also include parameters for a sphere, whose radius is 5.2 units, and for a cube, whose side length measures 7.3 units.  

Please use these dimensions when running the volume calculations, selecting the cylinder as the target shape.
